notes: Variable speed inverter heat pump with EC condenser and supply fans; R-454B refrigerant with refrigerant detection.
Provide with factory coastal protection coated outdoor coil and stainless steel fasteners (coil option C).
Provide with stainless steel body and frame, coastal protection coated coils and stainless steel fasteners (coil option E - BackPack only).
Cabinet color: gray (G, Focus IQ default), tan (X, BackPack default), white (W) or bronze (Z).
Provide with dual point power (separate heater circuit) - available on 208/230 V units with electric heat.
Provide with AIRSYS 5-year comprehensive warranty (R-454B School Air Solutions units; registration required).
